_comment: Fargate-based Batch compute environment -- same underlying compute as the ECS tasks in ecs/task-definition.json (for 01/07/08/09/Assemble), so this repo has one compute model throughout, not two. FARGATE_SPOT would cut cost further for the array jobs (02-06) at the price of occasional task interruption, which is safe here specifically because those scripts are resumable and re-running them just skips already-done ids -- see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md before switching. serviceRole: verify against current AWS docs whether this is required for a FARGATE-type environment (it has historically been optional, defaulting to the AWSServiceRoleForBatch service-linked role) before filling in a real ARN.
